description: This Java class 'LoanProductResolver' provides a method to resolve loan products by their name. It interacts with an external API via 'LoanProductsApi' to retrieve all loan products and finds the matching product to return its ID. It uses Spring annotations for caching and component scanning, and Lombok for boilerplate reduction.

classes.name: LoanProductResolver
classes.description: A Spring component that resolves loan product IDs by name using an external API.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns the ID of a loan product based on its name by querying the loan products API.
